description: People in Civgraph who never stood in an election it holds (Northern Ireland Office ministers, civil servants, party officers), registered so tenures can name them. Their ids are a block of their own (900001 and up) that the candidate id assignment never uses; scripts/build_person_registry_v2.py adds them to person_registry.json with keyedBy "registered". A person here who later stands must be merged into the candidate record, not registered twice (scripts/validate-facts-model.mjs checks). Schema: data/schemas/non-candidate-persons.schema.json.
